final: WITH pair_avgs AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) as avg_feerate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as overall_mean FROM pair_avgs), above_mean AS (SELECT pa.orderslink, pa.acctscope, pa.avg_feerate, (pa.avg_feerate - mc.overall_mean) as excess FROM pair_avgs pa CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc WHERE pa.avg_feerate > mc.overall_mean), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink ASC) as rnk FROM above_mean) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rnk
